name: Grand Hyatt Cayman Resort
insider_take: This luxury beachfront resort sits on the world-famous Seven Mile Beach, consistently ranked among the Caribbean's most pristine stretches of sand.
whats_special: The Grand Hyatt Cayman is the only resort on Seven Mile Beach featuring both oceanfront and lagoon-side accommodations. As part of The Hyatt Privé Program, guests enjoy exclusive perks like complimentary breakfast, room upgrades, and resort credits. The property's Blue Lagoon creates a unique ecosystem where guests can observe tropical fish and stingrays in crystal-clear waters.
pro_tip: Book a lagoon-view suite for stunning sunset views and direct access to the calm lagoon waters – perfect for families with young children or those seeking a more serene swimming experience.
dont_miss: The resort's signature Red Bay restaurant offers farm-to-table dining with ingredients sourced from local Caymanian farms. Visit nearby Stingray City, just a short boat ride away, where you can swim with friendly southern stingrays in their natural habitat – one of the world's most unique wildlife encounters.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on Seven Mile Beach
Luxurious rooms and suites with ocean views
Multiple dining options and premium amenities
Access to Hyatt Privé exclusive benefits and perks
cons: Remote Caribbean island location requires flight connections
